verdict.rationale: Keycloak's OIDC reference documents the Client Credentials grant, used when "clients (applications and services) want to obtain access on behalf of themselves rather than on behalf of a user", with client_secret or JWT authentication backed by service accounts. Service-account clients also appear in the SCIM setup and in client-credentials-obtained PATs for Authorization Services. Clients can be issued programmatically via dynamic client registration and the kcadm Admin CLI, and the resulting tokens can be introspected and revoked. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on community corroboration of the client-credentials/service-account flow in practice.
